find: if (result === undefined) return { layout: layout.name, status: 'absent' };
replace: if (result === undefined) return { layout: layout.name, status: 'ok', png: '', pageErrors: 0, measured: [] };
why: Issue #936. A partial sweep -- `--states`, `--layouts`, or one stopped part-way -- has a manifest whose results do not cover the grid. Treating an uncaptured pair as a normal cell puts an empty image where a gap belongs, so the page reads as a complete run with a few blank pictures rather than an incomplete one.
killedBy: sweepGrid: the sweep as a states-by-layouts grid marks a missing capture absent rather than dropping the cell
